claim_boundary: Development stage gate for translated physical waypoint revisits in one continuous MemoryMaze3D simulator episode. It is not sealed evaluation, policy free rollout, RGB generation, or a full visual world model.

task.episode: one continuous simulator instance; randomized A-B-A or B-A-B; no teleport after reset
task.waypoint_selection: the first four cells on a deterministic BFS path from the reset cell toward the farthest reachable cell
task.physical_route: visit all four waypoint centers, retrace to the start, restore the reset heading, then pad with simulator noops
task.controller: generator-only closed-loop pose controller; pose chooses official actions but is never saved as a model input
task.context_history: 10 post-action RGB frames containing a hash-disjoint, randomly relabeled sequence of two visible landmarks and hidden noops
task.return_anchor: the first waypoint in the return context exposes the correct prior target but is not written
task.headline_queries: three hidden delayed queries at physically revisited waypoints 1-3
task.content_remapping: waypoints 1-3 store different target identities across contexts; waypoint 0 is a clean control

paired_counterfactual_contract.purpose: the current translated query view and physical state cannot reveal context; only earlier visible history differs

model_inputs: frozen DINOv2 spatial broad-ROI pooled feature from the corresponding post-action simulator RGB frame

memory_contract.architecture: Window Transformer PFC plus action-only periodic SE(2) EC, frozen sparse place population, dynamic latent context, and one episode-local factorized covariance HPC
memory_contract.ec_calibration: fixed from generator-only action/pose calibration before task generation; simulator pose is not consumed by the model
memory_contract.query_targets: DINO features copied from strictly earlier visible write frames

vision_contract.feature: last normalized spatial patch map pooled over the fixed middle/lower broad ROI
vision_contract.visualization: nearest earlier write RGB under recalled DINO feature; never labeled as generated pixels

split_policy.sealed_test_policy: Do not generate or inspect before the translated development gate is accepted.

secondary_diagnostics_not_acceptance: physical pose versus action-only EC drift
stop_rules: If any physical waypoint or counterfactual pairing gate fails, stop before DINO encoding.
If paired current query RGB is not pixel-identical, stop before DINO encoding.
If action-only EC place geometry fails, do not attribute the result to context inference or HPC.
If single-seed mechanism interventions fail, do not expand seeds or open the sealed split.
Do not call this free rollout, RGB generation, or a complete world model.

pre_generation_erratum.change: Replace endpoint Euclidean distance >=2.5m with cumulative outbound graph path >=3.0m.
pre_generation_erratum.reason: The pre-freeze controller audit used the first four cells of a BFS path. A legitimate one-turn three-edge path translates 3m but has endpoint Euclidean distance sqrt(5)m; the old field name did not match the audited route contract.
